notes.title: Thank You for Joining the Playtests!
notes.notes:
[p]A huge thank you to everyone who participated in the playtests!
Your feedback was incredibly valuable, and I’ve done my best to implement all the fixes and improvements based on your suggestions.[/p][p]Special thanks to those who took the time to fill out the feedback form — your insights were especially helpful.[/p][p]Your support means a lot — stay tuned for more updates![/p]
